MOGE 60-90% / contractor 10-40% profit petroleum (sliding scale by daily production volume). One of highest government takes in Southeast Asia.
MOGE 15% undivided interest (onshore); option to increase to 25%. Offshore: MOGE right to buy in up to 20% on commercial discovery.
